name: Extract Vitality
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Fortitude against a creature within short range. On a win, the creature takes 1d4 damage and you regain that amount of Endurance. On a loss, it takes 1 damage and you regain 1 Endurance.

If the Condition you unchecked was Afraid, +1d damage.

Describe how you extract their vitality.
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: Add HEART to the damage roll.
